card.name: Just before the word qualify or qualified
card.fires_on: Words right before a likely 'qualify' or 'qualified' (or 'quality'), such as 'less', 'to', 'will', 'not' or 'out', where that word is expected next in text about eligibility or counting.

modes.label: Eligibility wording
modes.description: A linking word just before 'qualify', 'qualified' or 'eligible' in text about admission, services or programs.
modes.example: minimum levels of Ontario labour and materials are required<< to>> qualify for the program

modes.label: Counting or fitting a definition
modes.description: A word before 'count', 'fit' or 'qualify' when saying what meets a definition or standard.
modes.example: Standards delimiting exactly the kinds of transfers<< that>> count as aid vary.

modes.label: Quality word split
modes.description: The hyphen or partial word before 'ual' in a split word such as Gestalt-Qualität.
modes.example: as von Ehrenfels's earlier Gestalt<<-Q>>ualität had been.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward word pieces starting 'ual' (as in qualify) and away from the whole 'qual' forms.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before 'qualify' or 'qualified' is expected, as in who is eligible or what counts.
